decisions_fixed.BCa_limits: Report 5th and 95th BCa limits as one-sided 95% bounds.
decisions_fixed.bootstrap_p_values: Use the one-sided tail area of the centered stratified-bootstrap distribution; add one to numerator and denominator.
decisions_fixed.cell_weighting: Calculate trajectory metrics first and weight every preregistered cell equally.
decisions_fixed.decision_rule: P1-P4 pass only if all preregistered thresholds, the 80% directional-cell rule, zero primary execution failures, and the Holm-adjusted primary p-value pass. P5 is independent and has no Holm correction.
decisions_fixed.failure_rule: A written failed row or non-finite primary metric in a preregistered primary contrast arm forces its prediction to fail; failures in non-primary arms remain disclosed but do not alter the primary decision. Incomplete or structurally invalid schedules are refused rather than analyzed.
decisions_fixed.P1_directional_unit: The nine N by sigma strata; HYBRID rQ must be below IND rQ.
decisions_fixed.P2_cross_validation: Four deterministic folds, each holding out one complete translation-bias level; the full model adds standardized Hc.
decisions_fixed.P2_directional_unit: The nine N by topology strata; within-stratum Spearman rho across translation-bias levels must be positive.
decisions_fixed.P3_directional_unit: The nine N by SNR strata; HYBRID minus MEAN recall must be positive.
decisions_fixed.P4_pooling: For each attack, pool equal-sized replicate samples across N cells; calculate median and P95.
decisions_fixed.P4_worst_attack: Select the attack with the largest max(median/0.15, P95/0.30), using the attack name as a deterministic lexical tie-break.
decisions_fixed.P4_directional_unit: The nine N by attack cells; both the median and P95 bound must hold.
decisions_fixed.P5_regression: Ordinary least squares with intercept over all trajectory-level log(tau) and log(1/lambda2) pairs; equal replicate counts imply equal cell weight.

scope: Operational analysis choices left implicit by CCSU-MO-PREREG-001; no simulator dynamics, seed, design cell, outcome metric, threshold, or confirmatory result is changed.
